briefing.title: Briefing after cycle 011 — what the world is pressing on

channels.title: Ebola in eastern Congo has crossed into Kenya

lines.text: The Bundibugyo strain of Ebola in eastern Congo: 9,277 confirmed cases and 4,478 deaths by 14 October.
lines.say: The Bundibugyo strain of Ebola, in eastern Congo. Nine thousand, two hundred and seventy-seven confirmed cases, and four thousand, four hundred and seventy-eight deaths, by the fourteenth of October.

lines.text: That is more than twice the cases of early August.
Kenya reported its first imported case on 6 October.
lines.say: Kenya reported its first imported case on the sixth of October.

lines.text: No licensed vaccine exists for this strain.
In Kenya, contact tracing is still done on paper.

channels.title: El Niño heads for a historic peak

lines.text: NOAA puts the central Pacific at 2.1 degrees above normal.
lines.say: NOAA puts the central Pacific at two point one degrees above normal.

lines.text: A strong to very strong El Niño is likely into early 2027.
lines.say: A strong to very strong El Niño is likely into early twenty twenty-seven.

lines.text: The odds of a historic peak of 2.5 degrees stand at 70 to 83 percent.
lines.say: The odds of a historic peak of two and a half degrees stand at seventy to eighty-three percent.

lines.text: It lands on oceans that set a September record, in a month 1.63 degrees above pre-industrial.
lines.say: It lands on oceans that set a September record, in a month one point six three degrees above pre-industrial.

lines.text: COP31 meets in Antalya from 9 to 20 November.
lines.say: Cop thirty-one meets in Antalya, from the ninth to the twentieth of November.

lines.text: Current policies lead to about 2.8 degrees this century, full national pledges to about 2.6.
lines.say: Current policies lead to about two point eight degrees this century. Full national pledges, to about two point six.

lines.text: The lowest path that overshoots 1.5 degrees needs cuts of 18 percent by 2030.
lines.say: The lowest path that overshoots one and a half degrees needs cuts of eighteen percent by twenty thirty.

lines.text: The pledges deliver 5 to 8.
lines.say: The pledges deliver five to eight.

lines.text: Finance and adaptation remain stalled.

channels.title: Wildlife down 73 %, measured on what is monitored

lines.text: The Living Planet Index records an average decline of 73 percent since 1970.
lines.say: The Living Planet Index records an average decline of seventy-three percent since nineteen seventy.

lines.text: It rests on 35,803 population trends of 5,790 vertebrate species.
lines.say: It rests on thirty-five thousand, eight hundred and three population trends, of five thousand, seven hundred and ninety vertebrate species.

lines.text: 95 percent in Latin America and the Caribbean.
lines.say: Ninety-five percent in Latin America and the Caribbean.

lines.text: 85 percent in fresh water.
lines.say: Eighty-five percent in fresh water.

lines.text: That is what is monitored.

channels.title: Diseases returning on a warmer, less vaccinated map

lines.text: The EU and EEA recorded 1,715 West Nile infections and 130 deaths by 7 October, the most ever reported there.
lines.say: The European Union and the European Economic Area recorded one thousand, seven hundred and fifteen West Nile infections, and one hundred and thirty deaths, by the seventh of October. The most ever reported there.

lines.text: Nigeria counted 16,997 suspected cases of diphtheria and 596 deaths by week 34.
lines.say: Nigeria counted sixteen thousand, nine hundred and ninety-seven suspected cases of diphtheria, and five hundred and ninety-six deaths, by week thirty-four.

lines.text: How much of this is climate, and how much is lost surveillance and vaccination, is still open.

channels.title: The displaced the count does not reach

lines.text: UNHCR counts 117.3 million people forcibly displaced at mid-2025.
lines.say: The UN refugee agency counts one hundred and seventeen point three million people forcibly displaced, at the middle of twenty twenty-five.

lines.text: 67.8 million of them inside their own countries.
lines.say: Sixty-seven point eight million of them, inside their own countries.

lines.text: It calls that figure likely an underestimate.
It covers only 38 reporting countries.
lines.say: It covers only thirty-eight reporting countries.

channels.title: The first election with AI in every feed

lines.text: Before the American vote of 3 November, the Wesleyan Media Project counted 220 political ads made at least partly with AI.
lines.say: Before the American vote of the third of November, the Wesley-an Media Project counted two hundred and twenty political ads, made at least partly with AI.

lines.text: They cost over 137 million dollars.
lines.say: They cost over one hundred and thirty-seven million dollars.

lines.text: In 2024 it was under 50,000.
lines.say: In twenty twenty-four it was under fifty thousand.

lines.text: 27 percent carry an AI disclaimer.
lines.say: Twenty-seven percent carry an AI disclaimer.

lines.text: No federal rule requires one.

channels.title: AI and the first rung of work

lines.text: Workers aged 22 to 25 in the occupations most exposed to AI stand 19 percent below their less exposed peers.
lines.say: Workers aged twenty-two to twenty-five, in the occupations most exposed to AI, stand nineteen percent below their less exposed peers.

lines.text: A year earlier the gap was 13 percent.
lines.say: A year earlier the gap was thirteen percent.

lines.text: It comes from fewer hires.
Where is skill learnt once the entry job is gone?
lines.say: Where is skill learned, once the entry job is gone?

lines.text: Data-centre electricity rose 17 percent in 2025.
lines.say: Data centre electricity rose seventeen percent in twenty twenty-five.

lines.text: AI-focused data centres rose 50 percent.
lines.say: AI focused data centres rose fifty percent.

lines.text: The International Energy Agency projects 485 terawatt-hours doubling to about 950 by 2030.
lines.say: The International Energy Agency projects four hundred and eighty-five terawatt hours, doubling to about nine hundred and fifty by twenty thirty.

lines.text: Where operators do not report, the footprint is not known.

channels.title: The war on Iran as an energy shock far away

lines.text: Iran declared a prohibited zone around the Strait of Hormuz on 6 September.
lines.say: Iran declared a prohibited zone around the Strait of Hormuz on the sixth of September.

lines.text: No large ship had passed since early September.
The IMF sees 4.7 percent inflation in 2026, hardest for energy importers outside the technology chain.
lines.say: The International Monetary Fund sees four point seven percent inflation in twenty twenty-six, hardest for energy importers outside the technology chain.

lines.text: In the Philippines, which imports about 98 percent of its oil from the Middle East, a state think tank estimates 1.3 to 3.1 million people pushed into poverty.
lines.say: In the Philippines, which imports about ninety-eight percent of its oil from the Middle East, a state think tank estimates one point three to three point one million people pushed into poverty.
